title: Law to study how city agencies use messaging apps
summary: This bill would require the Department of Records and Information Services to create a working group studying city agencies' use of instant messaging platforms like text and chat apps. The group, including tech and legal officials and records experts, must report to the mayor and Council speaker within 180 days on agency practices and record-keeping recommendations. The report would be published on the department's website and the working group would dissolve after submitting it.
